title: DSAR Response Time: One Month, and the Data Source Question
meta_description: A DSAR is due within one month under the UK and EU GDPR, and a CCPA request in 45 days if the law applies. The CNIL faulted a data vendor on its source answers.
secondary_keywords: what to do if you receive a subject access request

image.takeaway: A DSAR is due within one month in the UK and EU; a CCPA request to know within 45 days, if the CCPA applies.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on DSAR response time: within one month under the UK and EU GDPR, and 45 days for a CCPA request to know if the CCPA applies.
